decisions.description: Preserve existing public invalid-input exception types and timing. Callers supply non-null providers, collections, entries, keys and factory delegates unless explicitly nullable. Extension overloads that bridge existing APIs inherit their validation. New independent entry points validate at their boundary with named ArgumentNullException/ArgumentException; internal invariants keep Infra checks. Do not retrofit guards without a compatibility review.
decisions.status: Selected during owner-requested remaining TODO implementation

decisions.description: Follow docs/lifecycle.md: bins stop on first disposer failure; provider phases and failed-construction cleanup use ordinary using/finally semantics, with the latest exception winning. No failure aggregation is introduced.
decisions.historical_description: Cleanup after one disposer throws is not guaranteed by the observed sequential bin loop. Decide continuation/aggregation and partial-failure ownership before selecting a full cleanup guarantee.
decisions.status: Selected during owner-requested remaining TODO implementation

decisions.description: A throwing Error callback replaces the exception being reported in sync and async paths. The latest exception wins; no secondary-exception Data storage is part of the contract.
decisions.historical_description: Decide precedence between original factory failure and diagnostic-callback failure, and cleanup aggregation, using actions/disposal tests and an explicit compatibility decision.
decisions.status: Selected during owner-requested remaining TODO implementation

decisions.description: Preserve production namespace-folder exceptions and use Xtate.IoC.Test.Examples for executable examples. The stale example instruction is corrected; no public example types are renamed.
decisions.status: Selected during owner-requested remaining TODO implementation

decisions.description: Prioritize externally consumed contracts and changed APIs. Require XML documentation on new or changed public contracts, with a shared guide for repeated overload semantics; do not require boilerplate on every unchanged declaration.
decisions.status: Selected during owner-requested remaining TODO implementation

decisions.description: Review cohesion, state ownership, dependency direction, failure transitions and completed/awaited path symmetry. Require a concrete defect or readability gain before extraction; numeric size thresholds alone do not justify changes. Measure performance-sensitive refactors independently.
decisions.status: Selected during owner-requested remaining TODO implementation

decisions.description: Concurrent resolution bookkeeping is supported. Coordinate service use and scope creation with disposal. GetImplementationEntry stays available after disposal. In-flight bin additions have best-effort object disposal. The known native-handle cleanup race remains a separate regression, not an accepted guarantee.
decisions.historical_description: Define supported concurrent resolve/add/dispose combinations and ownership on races, then verify lifecycle and singleton/scoped synchronization against that contract.
decisions.status: Selected during owner-requested remaining TODO implementation
